targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap original_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap returned_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap saved_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" [$__range]))

panels.title: Saved tokens over time by client (estimated, log scale)
panels.description: Estimated saved tokens per client and time bucket. The logarithmic axis keeps large outputs from flattening smaller values; zero values cannot be displayed. Gaps are connected for readability.

targets.expr: sum by (client) (sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap saved_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Average per-call reduction (% of context window, estimated)
panels.description: Average estimated tool-output tokens removed per call, divided by the configured context window size. This is not actual context occupancy or model token usage.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap saved_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" [$__range])) / ${context_window_tokens} * 100

panels.title: Cumulative context-window equivalents (estimated)
panels.description: Estimated output tokens removed across the selected range divided by the configured context window size. This cumulative equivalent is not the number of actual context windows saved.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap saved_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__range])) / ${context_window_tokens}

panels.title: Total output savings (%)
panels.description: 100 × total estimated saved tokens / total original tokens. Weighted by output size, not an average of call percentages. No data when original output is zero.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap saved_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap original_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Output savings per interval (%)
panels.description: Weighted savings percentage per client and time bucket. Gaps are connected for readability; no percentage is imputed for idle buckets.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (client) (sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap saved_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__interval])) / (sum by (client) (sum_over_time({app="smart-bash"} | label_format client="{{ if .client }}{{ .client }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}" | client=~"${client:regex}" | json | unwrap original_tokens_estimate | __error__="" [$__interval])) > 0)
